notes: Recall/precision checklist for evaluating extraction quality, not an exact-match target -- a correct extraction phrases each requirement differently from source.quote below.
source.spans marks source-document offsets a requirement originates from; source.quote is those spans' text, joined with ' ... ' when there is more than one span.

This case is a one-year, firm-fixed-price SERVICES acquisition (commercial cook/food-delivery services for the Marine Security Guard Residence at the U.S. Embassy Tallinn, Estonia) -- the first Department of State / overseas-post case in this corpus (all others are VA). Evaluated by FAR 9.104 responsibility determination plus price, not a multi-factor best-value tradeoff.

PIPELINE INPUT NOTE: the real solicitation is a 57-page RFQ plus an 8-page Amendment 0001 (SF-30) that revises the Statement of Work and adds a new submission item, plus a 2-page Q&A document (not itself a source for any topic -- it only explains why the amendment reduced reporting requirements, and clarifies delivery-schedule/dietary questions with no new checkable content). This fixture's source.document_path points at a hand-condensed derivative, '19EN1026Q0383_condensed.txt', assembled by concatenating verbatim excerpts of the amended solicitation (no paraphrasing or added text) -- this condensed file, not the original PDFs, is what must be passed to the pipeline via --requirements.

Deliberately excluded from the condensed document entirely: Section 2 (Contract Clauses, ~37K chars of standard DOSAR/FAR post-award clauses -- taxes, holidays, invoicing, COR appointment, export administration boycott provisions), Section 5 (Representations and Certifications, entirely '[Reserved]' placeholders), the FAR/DOSAR incorporated-by-reference clause tables in Sections 3-4, the Ombudsman/Advocate-for-Competition provision, and the SOW's personnel-conduct standards, personnel-security data collection (explicitly post-award: 'after award of the contract...'), food-safety/HACCP/quality-control procedures, and the deliverables table (Amendment 0001, Section 1 Item 10) except for the one line (Risk Management Plan) explicitly marked 'provide as part of proposal response' -- every other deliverable in that table is due only after award (e.g. 'COR, 5 days after award').

local_license_permit_conditional is is_mandatory: false -- its applicability is conditional on a fact that can vary ('if providing this service requires special license or permit'), matching the conditional-applicability rule used elsewhere in this corpus.

quote_due_date and submission_format_and_channel are is_text_verifiable: false -- both are facts about the submission process (when/how the quote was actually sent), not something the application's own content addresses.
